articles.title: 苹果发布搭载A20 Pro的iPad mini，10月28日预售
articles.summary: 苹果10月26日发布新款iPad mini，采用8.5英寸OLED屏幕、5.4毫米机身和A20 Pro芯片，首次支持IP67防尘防水，10月28日预售、11月6日上市。苹果称为该产品线迄今最大幅度更新。
articles.new_facts: 苹果发布新款iPad mini，采用8.5英寸OLED屏、5.4mm机身、A20 Pro芯片和IP67防护，10月28日预售、11月6日上市。
articles.limitations: 苹果未在新闻稿中公布各版本售价；A20 Pro的性能提升幅度为苹果官方数据，未提供独立测试。

facts.text: 苹果10月26日发布新款iPad mini，称这是该产品线迄今最大幅度更新。新机采用8.5英寸OLED屏幕，峰值亮度1200尼特，机身厚度5.4毫米，首次具备IP67防尘防水能力，并提供纳米纹理屏幕选项。

evidence.quote: Apple today unveiled the all-new iPad mini , featuring a stunning OLED display in an even thinner and lighter design, a huge leap in performance with A20 Pro, and water and dust resistance.
At 5.4 mm thin, the new iPad mini is more portable than ever
It also features an IP67 rating to protect against water and dust

facts.text: 新款iPad mini搭载采用2纳米工艺的A20 Pro芯片，7核GPU每个核心内置神经加速器，苹果称AI性能最高提升4.5倍、图形性能提升2.7倍。新机10月28日开启预售，11月6日上市。

evidence.quote: A20 Pro delivers a giant leap in performance for iPad mini, significantly boosting graphics and AI-intensive tasks. It is built using Apple’s latest 2-nanometer process technology
iPad mini delivers up to 4.5x faster AI performance than the previous generation
Customers can pre-order it along with the new Smart Folio starting Wednesday, October 28, with availability beginning Friday, November 6.

bilingual.title_en: Apple unveils iPad mini with A20 Pro, pre-orders open October 28

sentences.en: Apple released the new iPad mini on October 26, calling it the biggest update to the product line to date.
sentences.zh: 苹果10月26日发布新款iPad mini，称这是该产品线迄今最大幅度更新。

sentences.en: The new model features an 8.5-inch OLED display with a peak brightness of 1,200 nits, a 5.4mm-thick body, IP67 dust and water resistance for the first time, and an optional nano-texture display.
sentences.zh: 新机采用8.5英寸OLED屏幕，峰值亮度1200尼特，机身厚度5.4毫米，首次具备IP67防尘防水能力，并提供纳米纹理屏幕选项。

sentences.en: The new iPad mini is powered by the A20 Pro chip built on a 2nm process, with a 7-core GPU that has a neural accelerator built into each core; Apple says AI performance is up to 4.5 times faster and graphics performance up to 2.7 times faster.
sentences.zh: 新款iPad mini搭载采用2纳米工艺的A20 Pro芯片，7核GPU每个核心内置神经加速器，苹果称AI性能最高提升4.5倍、图形性能提升2.7倍。

sentences.en: Pre-orders for the new model open on October 28, and it goes on sale on November 6.
sentences.zh: 新机10月28日开启预售，11月6日上市。

articles.title: iOS 27.2为iPhone Duo增加Apple Pencil支持
articles.summary: 苹果10月26日发布iOS 27.2，为iPhone Duo折叠屏手机增加Apple Pencil支持和视频通话“Edge Light”功能，并扩展Siri AI语言支持。苹果此前称手写笔支持将在今年晚些时候推出，本次更新予以落实。
articles.new_facts: iOS 27.2正式发布，为iPhone Duo增加Apple Pencil支持和Edge Light视频补光功能；Siri AI新增五种语言。
articles.limitations: The Verge报道未说明Apple Pencil在iPhone Duo上的具体配对方式和兼容型号；苹果官方发布说明未在检索结果中直接获得。

facts.text: 据The Verge 10月26日报道，苹果发布iOS 27.2，为iPhone Duo折叠屏手机增加Apple Pencil支持，并新增“Edge Light”功能，在视频通话时为面部补光。苹果此前称该手写笔支持将在今年晚些时候推出。

evidence.quote: Apple has just released iOS 27.2, bringing Apple Pencil support to the iPhone Duo.
Apple previously said the iPhone Duo would add support for the Apple Pencil “later this year.”

facts.text: iOS 27.2还允许Siri AI在信息应用中执行建议操作，并新增法语、日语、韩语、葡萄牙语和西班牙语支持；照片和Image Playground加入谷歌SynthID水印支持。FaceTime群聊新增双摄像头同时拍摄功能。

evidence.quote: The iOS 27.2 update also allows Siri AI to take suggested actions in Messages, while adding support for Siri AI in more languages , including French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish.
Apple is rolling out support for Google’s SynthID AI watermark in Photos and Image Playground
group calls on FaceTime now support dual capture so you can show both what’s visible from your selfie cam and your back cameras.

bilingual.title_en: iOS 27.2 Adds Apple Pencil Support to iPhone Duo

sentences.en: According to a report by The Verge on October 26, Apple released iOS 27.2, adding Apple Pencil support to the iPhone Duo foldable phone and introducing a new "Edge Light" feature that lights up the face during video calls.
sentences.zh: 据The Verge 10月26日报道，苹果发布iOS 27.2，为iPhone Duo折叠屏手机增加Apple Pencil支持，并新增“Edge Light”功能，在视频通话时为面部补光。

sentences.en: Apple previously said that support for the stylus would arrive later this year.
sentences.zh: 苹果此前称该手写笔支持将在今年晚些时候推出。

sentences.en: iOS 27.2 also allows Siri AI to perform suggested actions in the Messages app and adds support for French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Spanish; Photos and Image Playground gain support for Google's SynthID watermarking.
sentences.zh: iOS 27.2还允许Siri AI在信息应用中执行建议操作，并新增法语、日语、韩语、葡萄牙语和西班牙语支持；照片和Image Playground加入谷歌SynthID水印支持。

sentences.en: FaceTime group chats add the ability to capture with both cameras simultaneously.
sentences.zh: FaceTime群聊新增双摄像头同时拍摄功能。

articles.event_key: Siri AI|扩展支持更多语言
articles.title: 苹果Siri AI新增法语、日语等五种语言支持
articles.summary: 苹果10月26日宣布，随27.2系统更新，Siri AI新增支持法语、日语、韩语、葡萄牙语和西班牙语，并计划年底前扩展至繁体中文、挪威语、土耳其语和越南语。Siri AI目前在欧盟的iOS、iPadOS和watchOS上不可用。
articles.new_facts: Siri AI随27.2更新新增五种语言支持；繁体中文、挪威语、土耳其语和越南语计划年底前上线；Siri AI在欧盟的iOS、iPadOS和watchOS上尚不可用。
articles.limitations: Siri AI仍为测试版，部分功能可能因地区和语言不可用；依赖服务器模型的功能有每日使用限制，未来扩展访问可能收费。

facts.text: 苹果10月26日宣布，随iOS 27.2、iPadOS 27.2、macOS 27.2、watchOS 27.2和visionOS 27.2发布，Siri AI新增支持法语、日语、韩语、葡萄牙语和西班牙语。苹果称繁体中文、挪威语、土耳其语和越南语支持将在年底前推出。

evidence.quote: With the 27.2 software updates released today, Siri AI — an entirely new version of Siri that is profoundly more capable, conversational, and personal — is expanding to more people around the world, with availability now in the French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish languages.
Language support for Siri AI will continue to expand, with availability in Chinese (traditional), Norwegian, Turkish, and Vietnamese coming by the end of the year.

facts.text: Siri AI目前为测试版，需要支持Apple Intelligence的设备并设置为受支持语言。苹果称，Siri AI目前在欧盟的iOS、iPadOS和watchOS上不可用，公司正与欧盟沟通寻求解决方案。部分依赖服务器模型的功能受每日使用限制，未来扩展访问将收费。

evidence.quote: Siri AI is available in beta in iOS 27.2, iPadOS 27.2, macOS 27.2, watchOS 27.2, and visionOS 27.2 and requires an Apple Intelligence-enabled device set to a supported language.
Siri AI is currently unavailable in the EU in iOS, iPadOS, and watchOS.
Expanded access to such features will be available for a fee in the future.

bilingual.title_en: Apple Siri AI Adds Support for Five More Languages Including French and Japanese

sentences.en: On October 26, Apple announced that with the release of iOS 27.2, iPadOS 27.2, macOS 27.2, watchOS 27.2 and visionOS 27.2, Siri AI now supports French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Spanish.
sentences.zh: 苹果10月26日宣布，随iOS 27.2、iPadOS 27.2、macOS 27.2、watchOS 27.2和visionOS 27.2发布，Siri AI新增支持法语、日语、韩语、葡萄牙语和西班牙语。

sentences.en: Apple said support for Traditional Chinese, Norwegian, Turkish and Vietnamese will roll out before the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 苹果称繁体中文、挪威语、土耳其语和越南语支持将在年底前推出。

sentences.en: Siri AI is currently in beta and requires a device that supports Apple Intelligence set to a supported language.
sentences.zh: Siri AI目前为测试版，需要支持Apple Intelligence的设备并设置为受支持语言。

sentences.en: Apple said Siri AI is currently unavailable on iOS, iPadOS and watchOS in the EU, and the company is in talks with the EU to seek a solution.
sentences.zh: 苹果称，Siri AI目前在欧盟的iOS、iPadOS和watchOS上不可用，公司正与欧盟沟通寻求解决方案。

sentences.en: Some features that rely on server models are subject to daily usage limits, and expanded access will be charged in the future.
sentences.zh: 部分依赖服务器模型的功能受每日使用限制，未来扩展访问将收费。
